attack_surface.title: CVE-2015-3306 - ProFTPD Improper Access Control Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-88779 - Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-102490 - Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-102489 - Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-104286 - Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-76504 - Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-86950 - Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-88772 - Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-88771 - Citrix NetScaler Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-67279 - Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-65660 - Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-87902 - WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-5430 - WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-71362 - Adobe Commerce and Magento Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Adobe Commerce and Magento contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without any user interaction.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-93952 - Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-prem contains an improper input validation vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data…

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-94127 - F5 BIG-IP APM Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: F5 BIG-IP APM contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability when access policy and an OAuth profile are configured on a virtual server. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-93616 - Check Point Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-85102 - Check Point Multiple Products Improper Certificate Validation Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Check Point Security Gateway and Check Point Spark Firewall using Site to Site VPN or Remote Access VPN contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the Gateway.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-7273 - Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Zyxel GS1900 series switches contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the CGI program which could allow a LAN-based, unauthenticated attacker to exploit the flaw and potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2025-39964 - Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-53266 - Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ebtables SNAT target which allows an ARP sender hardware address rewrite to write directly into a nonlinear socket-buffer fragment backed by a splice-imported file page. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS).…

attack_surface.title: CVE-2025-39682 - Linux Kernel Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy…

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-58704 - Google Pixel Improper Authorization Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Google Pixel devices contain an improper authorization vulnerability in the cellular modem. A logic error may allow an attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-76460 - Cisco Identity Services Engine Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-87886 - Acronis Backup Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM and extension for Plesk contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-76461 - Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQL Injection Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: Cisco AsyncOS software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway (SEG) contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-84869 - ConnectWise ScreenConnect Improper Privilege Management and Missing Authorization Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains both an improper privilege management and missing authorization vulnerability that may allow an attacker to transfer and execute files through an active remote session without authorization or host confirmation.

attack_surface.title: CVE-2026-42016 - JFrog Artifactory Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
attack_surface.summary: JFrog Artifactory contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that leads to a privilege escalation attack due to a validation check of the token signature/issuer and not the token’s scope.
